external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications, including the store admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which franchise colleagues the identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system from which group membership changes and leaver status are supplied overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state who controls the HR system or how it is protected.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider used by franchise colleagues to vouch for their sign-in.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-ins, signs tokens, and supplies public signing material to applications.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The text does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

processes.name: application
processes.description: An application that takes an identity-broker token and decides what a colleague may do from the groups in the token.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
processes.notes: The text does not identify the applications individually.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application on the corporate network that allows a holder of a token containing the store-manager group to change prices and void transactions across every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens for every application.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the key store is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The text does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: colleague sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague initiates sign-in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: franchise identity-provider vouch
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague uses the franchise identity provider for a sign-in that the provider vouches for.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: franchise sign-in assertion
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker, which takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: application token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to an application for use in deciding what the colleague may do.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token carrying a staff id and group list

data_flows.name: store admin console token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token used by the store admin console to determine authorization.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.
data_flows.data_description: Token carrying a staff id and group list

data_flows.name: public key fetch
data_flows.description: An application fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check a token signature.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token signing key

data_flows.name: store admin console use
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the store admin console to perform permitted administrative actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
data_flows.notes: The text states that a store-manager token permits changing prices and voiding transactions, but does not specify the interface or transport.
data_flows.data_description: Requests to change prices or void transactions

data_flows.name: overnight HR changes
data_flows.description: The HR system supplies group membership changes and leaver changes to the identity broker overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night, and that is also how leavers stop being colleagues.

data_flows.name: directory maintenance
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains its directory of colleagues and group membership.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: signing key access
data_flows.description: The identity broker accesses the signing key kept in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: sign-in audit records
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Colleagues' own devices at home from which they may sign in to the identity broker.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise environment
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled environment containing franchise colleagues and their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.basis: The description says the broker pulls group membership changes and leaver changes from the HR system.

assumptions.basis: The description says the directory contains colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.basis: The description says the key store holds the signing key used by the broker to sign tokens.
